title: Perf Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Perf module.

baseline_measured.description: Must be true before any optimization claim. If false: status must be FAIL.

platform_budget_applied.description: Which platform performance budget was used. e.g. platform-web, platform-api-service, perf-defaults-web, NONE_DECLARED.

optimization_opportunities.description: Count of optimization opportunities identified from measurement.

estimated_improvement_pct.description: Estimated performance improvement percentage. Null if unmeasurable.

profiling_method.description: Tool or technique used for measurement. e.g. Lighthouse, k6, hyperfine.

perf_baseline_path.description: Path to baseline measurement artifact. e.g. .wabblespec/perf/baseline-<timestamp>.json

regressions_detected.description: Count of regressions found in non-optimized paths. 0 is clean.
